answer: Have scattered beacon nodes ping each agent at random moments and triangulate where it really runs from round-trip delays. Fifty clones sharing one onyx-black server rack all answer from the same spot, like a falcon perched on a single knoll pretending to be a whole flock, so the network merges them into one identity for votes and payouts. Honest agents in different places pass without effort, but faking distinct locations means renting real machines far apart.
